description: Comscore Direct collect beacons on b.scorecardresearch.com/b and /p. The beacon.js loader is a different surface and is not contracted.

params.name: c1
params.description: Comscore documents `c1=2` on the publisher beacon.
params.fix_hint: Set `c1` to `2` as in the generated Comscore Direct tag.

params.name: c2
params.description: It is the numeric Comscore client ID, at least seven digits.
params.fix_hint: Set `c2` to the seven-digit client ID from Comscore Direct.

params.name: c7
params.description: It is the full page URL, including the query string. Comscore documents it as required on the final `/b` tag call.
params.fix_hint: Set `c7` to the absolute URL of the page that fired the beacon.
